description: Saves the review of the customer of the postmarital allocations of the partner, in the partners-postmarital-property step of alignment. Call get_alignment with this step first, and show the customer each item of the partner with its allocation. agree true accepts the allocation of the partner. agree false disagrees: the partner then picks again. Give an item for each item that has no review (customer_agrees null), in one call. Give the separate_property of each item as get_alignment gave it. When an item changed after the read, the tool saves nothing: read the step again, and show the new allocation to the customer. An item that you do not give keeps its review. Then complete the step with complete_alignment_step.

id.description: The id of a partner item from get_alignment.

separate_property.description: The separate_property of the item that the customer saw in get_alignment.

name: review_partner_property
title: Review the partner's postmarital property
